title_zh: 建行重庆分行第一次用数字人民币借钱给其他金融机构
title_en: CCB's Chongqing branch lends money to other financial institutions with the digital yuan for the first time

paragraphs.zh: 据移动支付网11月26日报道，中国建设银行重庆市分行用数字人民币完成了一笔同业借款，金额一共是50亿元。
paragraphs.en: According to a Mpaypass report on November 26, China Construction Bank's Chongqing branch completed an interbank loan using the digital yuan, worth 5 billion yuan in total.

paragraphs.zh: 这笔钱借给了两家金融租赁公司。其中，中银金租借了30亿元，渝农商金租借了20亿元，两笔钱是同时发出的。
paragraphs.en: The money was lent to two financial leasing companies. Of this, BOC Financial Leasing borrowed 3 billion yuan and Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank's leasing company borrowed 2 billion yuan; the two amounts were sent out at the same time.

paragraphs.zh: 同业借款就是金融机构之间互相借钱。以前，这种钱一般是通过银行账户转过去的。这一次，建行把钱发给对方的时候用的是数字人民币，钱付出去以后马上就能到账。
paragraphs.en: An interbank loan simply means financial institutions lending money to each other. In the past, this kind of money was usually transferred through bank accounts. This time, CCB used the digital yuan when sending the money to the borrowers, so the money arrived right after it was paid out.

paragraphs.zh: 报道说，这是重庆第一笔用数字人民币的同业借款，在建行全行也是第一笔。数字人民币是中国人民银行发行的法定数字货币，现在已经在很多城市使用。
paragraphs.en: The report said this is Chongqing's first interbank loan using the digital yuan, and also the first across the whole of CCB. The digital yuan is the legal digital currency issued by the People's Bank of China, and it is now used in many cities.

vocab.en: according to (据…报道 = according to a report by…)
Mpaypass (China Mobile Payment Network, a news site)
(measure word for sums of money / deals)
Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Financial Leasing
(of money) to arrive in an account
People's Bank of China (PBOC, the central bank)

featured.en: digital yuan; e-CNY (China's central bank digital currency)
featured.note: Often shortened to 数币. Collocations: 数字人民币钱包 (e-CNY wallet), 用数字人民币支付 (pay with e-CNY), 数字人民币试点 (e-CNY pilot), 数字人民币跨境支付 (cross-border e-CNY payment).

examples.zh: 越来越多的银行开始用数字人民币做企业之间的结算。
examples.py: Yuè lái yuè duō de yínháng kāishǐ yòng shùzì rénmínbì zuò qǐyè zhījiān de jiésuàn.
examples.en: More and more banks are starting to use the digital yuan for settlement between companies.

examples.zh: 我在超市用手机里的数字人民币钱包付了钱。
examples.py: Wǒ zài chāoshì yòng shǒujī lǐ de shùzì rénmínbì qiánbāo fù le qián.
examples.en: I paid at the supermarket with the digital yuan wallet on my phone.

examples.zh: 我们想看看这个月有多少商户开通了数字人民币收款。
examples.py: Wǒmen xiǎng kànkan zhège yuè yǒu duōshao shānghù kāitōng le shùzì rénmínbì shōukuǎn.
examples.en: We want to see how many merchants turned on digital yuan payment collection this month.

featured.en: (of money) to arrive in / be credited to an account
featured.note: Very common in payments: 实时到账 (real-time crediting), 秒到账 (arrives in seconds), 到账时间 (time to credit), 还没到账 (hasn't arrived yet).

examples.zh: 这家支付公司说，商户的钱第二天就能到账。
examples.py: Zhè jiā zhīfù gōngsī shuō, shānghù de qián dì-èr tiān jiù néng dàozhàng.
examples.en: This payment company says merchants' money will be credited the next day.

examples.zh: 我的工资今天早上已经到账了。
examples.py: Wǒ de gōngzī jīntiān zǎoshang yǐjīng dàozhàng le.
examples.en: My salary arrived in my account this morning.

examples.zh: 我们需要分析一下转账的平均到账时间。
examples.py: Wǒmen xūyào fēnxī yíxià zhuǎnzhàng de píngjūn dàozhàng shíjiān.
examples.en: We need to analyse the average time it takes for transfers to arrive.
